$comment: Tenant data-controller notice (owner requirement, 2026-11-11). PLACEHOLDER WORDING - PENDING COUNSEL REVIEW. Counsel edits this file (no code change). Bumping `version` (with a new `publishedAt`) requires every tenant admin to re-accept: a NEW category blocks until accepted; a CHANGED version keeps fetches working for `graceDays`, then blocks. An acceptance records the version AND a sha256 of the text it was shown; it stays current only while both match, so editing the wording WITHOUT bumping the version invalidates acceptances immediately (no grace) - always bump the version.
title: Your data, your responsibility
intro: [PLACEHOLDER - PENDING COUNSEL REVIEW] Data you bring into Omnivyra from the sources below is stored in your workspace. You (your organisation) are the data controller for it; Omnivyra processes it on your behalf. You are responsible for meeting the data-protection laws that apply to you, including the GDPR, the CCPA and India's DPDP Act: having a lawful basis, honouring opt-outs and deletion requests, and setting retention.

categories.vendor_data: [PLACEHOLDER] Data vendors (for example Apollo), whether you connect your own key or use Omnivyra's centralized access: the people and company records they return are stored in your workspace under your responsibility.
categories.salesnav_capture: [PLACEHOLDER] LinkedIn Sales Navigator capture: the saved-lead details captured by the Omnivyra extension are stored in your workspace under your responsibility.
categories.contact_data: [PLACEHOLDER] Contact data (work email; phone later): personal contact details carry additional obligations. Only fetch them where you have a lawful basis to contact the person, and honour opt-outs and deletion requests.
